title: Can LLMs Understand What They Predict? Evaluating Latent Causal Structure Inference in Financial Markets
abstract: arXiv:2611.23533v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly evaluated through their ability to predict future outcomes, implicitly assuming that predictive success reflects an understanding of the underlying system. However, accurate predictions can often be achieved without recovering the latent mechanisms that generate observable outcomes. To examine this assumption, we introduce LUCID, a benchmark that evaluates whether models can infer latent market structures from event descriptions and historical financial observations. Models generate event-induced causal graphs representing inferred market structure and are evaluated through a reconstruction-based framework. Our evaluation of 6 open-weight and proprietary LLMs shows that adding their generated graphs generally reduces reconstruction quality compared with using historical observations alone, although a few metrics improve. translated_title: LLM能理解它们所预测的内容吗？评估金融市场中的潜在因果结构推断
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地通过其预测未来结果的能力来评估，这隐含地假设预测的成功反映了对底层系统的理解。然而，准确的预测往往可以在不恢复产生可观测结果的潜在机制的情况下实现。为了检验这一假设，我们引入了LUCID，这是一个评估模型能否从事件描述和历史金融观测数据中推断潜在市场结构的基准。模型生成代表所推断市场结构的事件诱导因果图，并通过基于重构的框架进行评估。我们对6个开源权重和专有LLM的评估表明，与仅使用历史观测数据相比，加入模型生成的因果图通常会降低重构质量，尽管少数指标有所改善。这些发现表明，推断有信息量的、针对特定事件的市场（结构）……
tldr: 该论文提出LUCID基准，评估大语言模型能否从事件描述和历史金融数据中推断潜在的因果市场结构，发现模型生成的因果图通常无法改善重构质量，表明预测成功并不等于真正理解了底层机制。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces LUCID, a benchmark that evaluates whether LLMs can infer latent causal market structures from event descriptions and historical financial observations, finding that LLM-generated causal graphs generally reduce reconstruction quality, suggesting predictive success does not imply genuine understanding of underlying mechanisms.
